## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request references its issue and targets the integration branch.
- [ ] The change is focused and each commit is coherent.
- [ ] Commit messages are single-line Conventional Commits in English,
      with at most one scope and no breaking change.
- [ ] Commits are signed with the contributor's configured identity.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] `make docs` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration reference implemented features only.
